summary: This bill repeals the temporary protected status program under the Immigration and Nationality Act, immediately ends all current grants, and requires affected noncitizens to leave the United States within 60 days.

scores.thoughts: The bill repeals temporary protected status under immigration law with no provisions affecting federal spending levels, appropriations, or budgets.
No provisions relate to tax rates, revenue collection, or tax policy.
No provisions address healthcare access, funding, or regulation.
No provisions relate to firearms, regulations, or Second Amendment issues.

The bill's sole purpose is to repeal section 244 of the Immigration and Nationality Act, eliminating the TPS program entirely and terminating all existing grants with a 60-day departure requirement. This directly restricts an immigration protection pathway and enforces stricter border/immigration policy.
